svg.aria-label: Animated diagram. The largest loop among LUX's concepts ties 2,190 concepts together with 5,697 broader edges. Removing 620 of those edges would break every loop; their ends touch 794 concepts. The shortest loop through each of the 620 is packed into 35 fragments of at most 60 concepts, 1,106 different concepts in all, each fragment built around the ends of those edges. Judged a fragment at a time with Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, the component came apart in three passes of 35, 10 and 1 fragments: 630 deletions for $0.28, with no concept left in a loop.

g.text: The largest loop among LUX’s concepts ties 2,190 concepts together with 5,697 broader edges.
Removing just 620 of those edges would break every loop. Their ends touch 794 concepts.
The shortest loop through each of the 620 is packed into 35 fragments of at most 60 concepts.
Judged a fragment at a time, the knot came apart in three passes: 630 deletions for $0.28.
THE LARGEST CONCEPT LOOP · 2,190 CONCEPTS · 5,697 BROADER EDGES
an end of one of the 620 edges whose removal leaves no loop (794 concepts)
an end of one of the 620
· 1,106 different concepts, some in several fragments
One dot per concept; positions carry no meaning. Pass results from the run recorded in the lux-concepts-scc README.
